name: Review an authorised service defensively
short_description: Review an owned or explicitly authorised service for five common weakness classes and document reproducible evidence safely.
self_assessment: I can review one authorised service for five weakness classes without help and avoid harming availability or data.
description: Review an owned or explicitly authorised service for five common weakness classes and document reproducible evidence safely. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Review a deliberately vulnerable local service
safety_note: Security testing can disrupt systems or expose data; obtain explicit permission, limit scope, protect evidence, and stop if availability or real data is at risk.
